skills.name: tba-brainstorming
skills.purpose: Design conversation for TBA PlanMan: read the card and repo first, fill a 5-area coverage ledger, ask only what the code cannot answer, offer approaches, write plan.md.
skills.source: adapted from the brainstorming skill of https://github.com/obra/superpowers and merged with the 5-phase checklist of the TBA design command

skills.name: ponytail
